actors.name: Donald Trump
actors.blurb: President Trump's visit to Ireland generated significant coverage due to his diplomatic meetings, golf course visits, and comments favoring a united Ireland. Meanwhile, his administration faces court rulings striking down federal staffing cuts and coal plant orders, alongside ongoing debates over midterm strategy and foreign policy.
